test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech.

He said, "I have completed the task."

options.text: He said that he has completed the task.
He said that he was completing the task.
He said that he completed the task.
He said that he had completed the task.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He said that he had completed the task.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I have completed the task" becomes "He had completed the task"**
 
 
• Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to match the subject of the indirect sentence.
 
• Verb "have completed" is converted to "had completed" to shift the tense from present perfect to past perfect.
 
 
 
• **Reporting verb:**
 
 
• Indirect: "He said that" introduces the reported speech.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted into a subordinate clause introduced by "that".
 
• Quotation marks are removed, and the sentence is transformed into a declarative statement.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said that he had completed the task."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "He said that he has completed the task." 

 
 
• Incorrect tense: "has completed" remains in the present perfect instead of shifting to past perfect.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "He said that he was completing the task." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "was completing" suggests an action in progress, altering the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "He said that he completed the task." 
 
 
• Incorrect tense: "completed" does not match the required past perfect tense.
